title: The Girls Refuse to Lose Her — Part 2

series.summary: With Hakari pulled away, the other girlfriends gather at the mansion. The mood swings from uneasy comedy to desperation, a girl collapses in the hallway, and the group realizes winning Hakari back will take an actual operation.

segments.voiceover_text: With Hakari gone, the rest of the girlfriends crowd into the mansion lounge. Nobody is laughing. Rentarou's worry hangs over the whole room. They all like the same boy. Tonight that might be the only thing that saves him.
The jokes cannot survive this mood. One thought keeps surfacing, and it is not funny anymore. They cannot forget what Hahari said. This will take a real operation.
Then the night turns ugly. A girl lies collapsed on the hallway floor. A hand reaches out for her. Panic spreads fast. Whatever the mother planned, the cost is getting real.
